test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which statement regarding the "green rail corridor' (launched in Tamil Nadu) is NOT correct?

options.text: The stretch of the green rail corridor is 114 km.
The trains under green rail corridor are equipped with bio toilets.
It is India's first green rail corridor.
It was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The "**green rail corridor" refers to a rail route where all the passenger trains are equipped with bio-toilets to prevent human waste discharge on the railway tracks.**
 
• **This initiative is part of India's broader efforts** to enhance sanitation and environmental sustainability in its railway networK.
 
• It was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
 
• This statement is NOT correct.
 
• The green rail corridor was inaugurated on July 24, 2016, by the then Railway Minister Suresh Prabhu, not by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The stretch of the green rail corridor is 114 km**.

 
 
• This statement is correct.
 
• The stretch between Rameswaram and Manamadurai in Tamil Nadu is 114 km long and was declared a green corridor.
 
 
 
• **The trains under the green rail corridor are equipped with bio-toilets.**
 
 
• This statement is also correct.
 
• The bio-toilets treat waste in a way that reduces pollution and improves hygiene.
 
 
 
• **It is India's first green rail corridor**.
 
 
• This statement is true.
 
• The Rameswaram-Manamadurai section was India's first fully functional green rail corridor, marking a significant step towards greener rail transport.
